name: Motoba Kirie
source: Umaru's classmate with frightening eyes that scare others and that watches Umaru intensely. It turns out she is very shy and has a great admiration for her. She considers Ebina a rival for Umaru's affections. She is a member of the swim club and is good at other sports like tennis. She aspires to be a picture book author.
